title: Chain of Thought Still Thinks Fast: APriCoT Helps with Thinking Slow
reasoning: The paper focuses on cognitive reasoning paradigms (System 1 vs System 2) and statistical biases like base-rate probability (BRP) within LLMs. While it mentions the goal of developing 'fair' models in the abstract, the research does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
